goal: Require authenticated exact workflow-run and artifact provenance before a shared-db live proof can complete a structural outcome
prohibited_actions: Do not dispatch the live-proof workflow or touch production
Do not accept another workflow, event, attempt, head, or artifact run as live proof
Do not weaken the existing proof JSON, name, digest, expiry, or default-branch checks
Do not merge this pull request
assumptions: The shared-db live-proof producer is .github/workflows/shared-db-live-proof.yml under workflow_dispatch on popcre/shared-db
The authenticated GitHub artifact response carries workflow_run.id and workflow_run.head_sha
stop_conditions: Stop if exact run and artifact provenance cannot be verified through GitHub API evidence
Stop if changes would require database schema, data, or production mutation
Stop if governed review or required checks refuse
